blocks.text: Deuteronomy 1 opens with Moses recounting the wilderness history, setting the stage for his covenant address to Israel. Deuteronomy as a whole moves from this remembered wilderness history through covenant instruction to covenant consequences, renewal, succession, final song, blessing, and Moses's death. Chapter 1 provides the historical foundation—recalling God's command at Horeb to possess the land and the journey through the wilderness—upon which the covenant instruction to follow is built.
